stories.dek: C.J. Stroud throws three touchdowns, the Houston defense takes the early lead for the Week 11 payout, and Jonathan Taylor gets 6.7 for Llamageddon.
body: Week 11 is on the board, and Stroud of Turin is the team smiling about it. C.J. Stroud went 21 of 27 for 194 yards, three touchdowns and an interception in Houston's 26-3 win over the Colts, good for 21.46 points, and Xavier Hutchinson, the $10 waiver claim RedDevil904 made Wednesday, added 3.3. That's a 24.76 to 0.00 lead on NjigbaR Please!, which had nobody in the game, in the Matchup of the Week. The line was Stroud of Turin by 11.5, and RedDevil904 is already up more than double that before Sunday.

The other Thursday games. Wild Goose Chase leads Nothing to see here 19.00 to 0.00: Nico Collins caught three passes for 58 yards and a touchdown (15.8) and Tyler Warren added 3.2, while Woody Marks sat out for ChuckJ10. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered leads Achane in the Membrane 16.00 to 15.40 in the strangest race of the night: the Houston defense held the Colts to 3 points for 16.0, and David Montgomery ran 26 times for 107 yards for 15.4. Llamageddon leads Lead Nagger 6.70 to 0.00 because Jonathan Taylor, the top-scoring running back on any roster in this league, ran into that same Houston defense.

On the benches: Dalton Schultz scored 2.1 for Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, Tank Dell (5.7) and Emari Demercado (4.9) scored for Lead Nagger, and Seth McGowan scored 6.48 for MY DAD IS DEAD before he was ruled out with a hamstring injury, per NFL Network's Jane Slater. Pudge247 added Demercado as a free agent Wednesday, so at least he put up something, just not anywhere it counts.

The Week 11 payout is the highest-scoring defense, and the Houston defense on Breece'sBurdenDeflowered leads with 16.0. The other 11 starting defenses play Sunday and Monday. stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker trades Jordan Addison to Pudge247 for Chimere Dike, and I'd like a word with myself
stories.dek: The commish's receiver room lost Wan'Dale Robinson for the season and Addison to thumb surgery in the same week. So he traded one for a Titan.
body: The trade, processed Nov 19 at 9:04 AM ET: My Dad is Dead2 gets Chimere Dike, Lead Nagger gets Jordan Addison. That's it, one for one. Addison had thumb surgery this week; Kevin O'Connell said it went well and that Addison will not go on injured reserve, but there is no return date, per 4for4. Dike has 13 catches and 29.5 PPR points in 9 games per Sleeper and scored 10.34 on the Lead Nagger bench in Week 10.

Why I did it, since I'm the one who did it: my receivers are falling apart. Titans coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Wan'Dale Robinson is out for the season with an ankle injury (TSN). Robinson had 81.3 points in 9 games on my bench. Addison was out this week regardless, and Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield are on the Rams' bye. Dike plays for the same Tennessee team that just lost Robinson, so somebody has to catch Cam Ward's passes, and I'm betting it's my guy. Dike is in my Week 11 lineup. I also dropped Tutu Atwell Wednesday night, which was the least controversial move I've made all year.

Why Pudge247 did it: Addison has 53.9 points in 7 games this year, including 21.0 in Week 3 (on my bench, naturally), and Lead Nagger has the most points in the league and a deep enough roster to park a receiver until he's back for a playoff run. Pudge247 also added Emari Demercado as a free agent the same morning. Lead Nagger is the projected champion; he's shopping for January, and I'm shopping for Sunday.

Verdict: too early to call, and it's in the trade history as such. If Dike gets Robinson's targets and Addison misses a month, I win the trade. If Addison is back for the Wild Card round and Dike keeps catching two balls a game, I traded a starter for a guy I'll cut in December. Either way, I'm 7-3, the projected 2 seed, and I just made a trade with the projected champion. Somebody check on me.

stories.title: Puka Nacua suspended while on IR, Wan'Dale Robinson done for the season, and Friday's question marks
stories.dek: Every injury and status note that touches a league roster heading into Sunday, verified against the reports.
body: Puka Nacua (Llamageddon): the NFL suspended him three games for violating the personal conduct policy, and he will serve it while on injured reserve, per ESPN's Adam Schefter via NBC Sports. He is eligible to return for the Rams' Week 15 game. For dcrabb, that means no Nacua for the rest of the regular season, which ends in Week 14, and a possible return for the Climax Bracket's second round if Llamageddon gets there. Nacua has 173.6 points in 7 games. Llamageddon's playoff odds are 25%.

Wan'Dale Robinson (My Dad is Dead2 bench): out for the season with an ankle injury, per Titans coach Robert Saleh (TSN). Jordan Addison, now on Lead Nagger, had thumb surgery and won't go on IR, per Kevin O'Connell. Drake Maye (Wild Goose Chase) is still out after his ankle injury in Germany, and New England is on bye anyway. Seth McGowan (MY DAD IS DEAD bench) left Thursday's game with a hamstring injury.

Kenneth Walker III (groin) did not practice for Lead Nagger. Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) was limited for Llamageddon. Mike Evans (Achilles) was limited for Breece'sBurdenDeflowered. Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand), Caleb Douglas (shoulder) and Darren Waller (knee) were limited for Nothing to see here. T.J. Hockenson (wrist) and Ladd McConkey (back) were limited for MY DAD IS DEAD. Jordyn Tyson (chest) was limited for NjigbaR Please!.

Good news, for once: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) practiced fully for Achane in the Membrane, DeVonta Smith (hamstring) practiced fully for My Dad is Dead2, and Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) practiced fully and is in the Bijan is your daddy lineup. columns.title: STROUD OF TURIN GETS FIRST BLOOD TONIGHT. Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner wants to know why it's only the 5 seed
columns.dek: 194.14 last week, C.J. Stroud at home on Thursday night, and the Climax Bracket still has RedDevil904 losing in the Wild Card. Barry McCockiner has notes. Loud ones.
body: I want everybody to sit down. I want everybody to look at the number. ONE NINETY-FOUR POINT ONE FOUR. That is what Stroud of Turin dropped on Breece'sBurdenDeflowered last week, the best score anybody in this league has put up all year, with a PERFECT lineup, and a 79.08-point margin. And what did this league do about it? NOTHING. You went back to talking about the 8-2 team.

Here's the resume. Stroud of Turin is 6-4. It has 1,297.92 points, second in the league. It scores 129.79 a week, second in the league. Its all-play record is 68-42, second in the league. Second, second, second. You know who finishes second in everything? THE GUY WHO WINS THE WHOLE THING WHILE EVERYBODY ELSE IS STARING AT FIRST.

And TONIGHT, before anybody else in this league gets to play, C.J. Stroud takes the field in Houston. 187.48 points in 9 games. That's 20.83 a game from the quarterback the team is NAMED AFTER. Xavier Hutchinson, the guy RedDevil904 blew his last $10 on, plays tonight too. While dstafford4254 is sitting there trying to figure out how to replace four starters on bye, RedDevil904 could be up thirty before Friday. THIRTY!

Now the bad part, and I need you to brace yourselves. The Climax Bracket, which runs 20,000 seasons, has Stroud of Turin as the 5 seed at 8.3 projected wins with 87% playoff odds, and it has Stroud of Turin LOSING in the Wild Card to Lead Nagger. 54 percent. FIFTY-FOUR. That is not a prediction, that is a coin with a slight limp. I REFUSE to accept a coin with a limp.

I'm HEARING that RedDevil904 has been calling the Sleeper app every night asking to be moved up to the 2 seed on vibes alone, and that when Sleeper said it doesn't have a phone number, he left a voicemail anyway. Word is the voicemail was just him reading the number 194.14 over and over for eleven minutes. None of this is confirmed. I made it up in the press box parking lot. But you KNOW it sounds right.

So here's my take and I am SCREAMING it: Stroud of Turin is the most dangerous team in this league and it is getting a head start tonight. The line says 11.5 over NjigbaR Please!. I'd lay it. I'd lay it TWICE. And if C.J. Stroud throws for three tonight, I want an apology from every one of you, IN WRITING, BY FRIDAY!

columns.title: Dick Fitzwell: rtmcruise cut the quarterback who just threw for 340. Pick a guy and stop flinching
columns.dek: Three straight losses, Matthew Stafford on bye, and two quarterback moves in 24 hours. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered isn't rebuilding. It's panicking with a plan.
body: Here's the tape. Monday night, Jacoby Brissett throws 49 times for 340 yards in his first game in Baltimore. Wednesday morning, rtmcruise adds Cam Ward. Thursday morning, rtmcruise claims J.J. McCarthy for $0 and cuts Brissett. That's not a quarterback room. That's a revolving door.

The numbers, from Sleeper. Brissett: 130.96 points in 9 games, 14.55 a game. Ward: 125.66 in 9, 13.96 a game. McCarthy: 53.1 in 5, 10.62 a game. The guy who got cut has the best per-game number of the three. I've seen linebackers get benched for less than that, and they usually deserved it more.

Is there an argument? Sure, there's always an argument. Stafford is on bye, so you need a Week 11 starter, and Ward is fine. Maybe rtmcruise doesn't like Baltimore's line, or wants a second young arm for the playoff weeks. Fine. But you don't need two backups for one bye. You need one, and you already had the best one. That's soft roster management. You flinched.

And Breece'sBurdenDeflowered can't afford to flinch. It's 5-5 with three straight losses, a 51-59 all-play record and 117.74 points a week, eighth in the league. The Climax Bracket has it at 6.7 projected wins and 21% playoff odds. This week it's a 6.5-point underdog to Achane in the Membrane, which just put up 170.24 with a perfect lineup. Josh Jacobs and A.J. Brown are out. Dalton Schultz and the Houston defense play tonight, and that's a start.

Word around the film room is that rtmcruise has a third quarterback move queued up for Friday, and that it's picking up Brissett again for $0 and telling everyone it was the plan all along, a fake-cut to throw off the league. I'm told the play has a name and the name is "Boomerang Right." None of this is confirmed. I don't believe it either.

Bottom line. Pick a quarterback, start him, and live with it. Ward has the season numbers and the matchup is the matchup. Four games left, and you probably need three of them. That's not a week to be cute. That's a week to hit somebody.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's six-step plan for dstafford4254 to erase a 24.76-point Thursday hole
columns.dek: NjigbaR Please! is down 24.76 to 0.00 before it plays a snap. Oliver Klozoff has a plan, a lawn chair and no business giving advice.
body: Folks, I watched Thursday night from the lawn chair with the bad leg, and I saw C.J. Stroud throw three touchdowns for 21.46 points, Xavier Hutchinson add 3.3, and NjigbaR Please! go down 24.76 to 0.00 without anybody on the field. dstafford4254, I'm here for you. Here is your plan.

1. Bench everybody. Think about it: if you score 0.00, you can only lose by 24.76 plus whatever Stroud of Turin does on Sunday. If you score points, you're just giving the other guy something to beat. Defense wins championships.

2. Stroud of Turin averages 129.79 points a week and has already scored 24.76. That means it only has 105.03 left in the tank. NjigbaR Please! averages 123.96. 123.96 is bigger than 105.03. You're actually up 18.93. Nobody's told the scoreboard yet.

3. Start Alvin Kamara, Kaelon Black and Jordyn Tyson. They scored 50.0 on your bench last week, and points on the bench clearly don't count, so the only logical move is to put them somewhere they do. Wait, you already did this. Then ignore step 1. 4. Your best score this year is 162.14, in Week 4. Just do that again. 5. Your worst is 84.56, in Week 5. Don't do that again. That's the whole playbook. 6. The line was 11.5. You're down 24.76. That's only 13.26 worse than the line, which is basically the line.

Word around the cul-de-sac is that dstafford4254 has already emailed the commish asking whether Thursday points can be refunded for teams that had nobody playing, like a rain check at a ballgame, and that Bill_Buttlicker replied with a picture of the scoreboard. None of this is confirmed, and I made up the email, the picture and the cul-de-sac.

Bottom line: Stroud of Turin is still a 64% favorite on the line, and that number came out before Thursday. I've got NjigbaR Please! by a touchdown, or eight, whatever's easier. Chair's not getting any younger, and neither is this lead.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: the five teams that scored Thursday are exactly .500, so Thursday points are worth exactly nothing
columns.dek: 81.86 points went up on Thursday night. Connie Lingus ran the numbers and has determined, with total confidence, that none of them matter.
body: Five teams in this league got points on Thursday night: Stroud of Turin (24.76), Wild Goose Chase (19.00), Breece'sBurdenDeflowered (16.00), Achane in the Membrane (15.40) and Llamageddon (6.70). Their combined record coming into Week 11 is 25-25. The seven teams that got nothing are a combined 35-35. Both groups are exactly .500. You know what that tells me? Thursday points have a predictive value of precisely zero. I'm not saying Stroud of Turin is tied with NjigbaR Please!. The math is saying it.

Let's go deeper, because I always do. Seven starters played on Thursday and scored 81.86 points, or 11.69 per starter. The average starting slot in this league has scored 13.31 points per week this season. So the Thursday starters underperformed the league by 1.62 points each, which means every team that got Thursday points is technically losing to its own average. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is up 0.60 on Achane in the Membrane. That's 0.60 points of pure regression waiting to happen.

Stroud of Turin's 24.76 is 19.1% of its 129.79 season scoring average. With roughly 81% of the week left to play, the 24.76 is, statistically speaking, a rounding error with a touchdown pass attached. And Llamageddon's 6.70 lead on Lead Nagger came from Jonathan Taylor, the top-scoring running back on any roster in the league, scoring less than the 10.6 that Tank Dell and Emari Demercado put up on the Lead Nagger bench. When the best back in the league gets outscored by a bench, I call that a market inefficiency. I don't know which market.

Sources say Br0phy left Tucker Kraft in the Wild Goose Chase FLEX on purpose, because a player on bye has a standard deviation of exactly 0.00, which makes Kraft the lowest-risk asset on the roster. I'm told Br0phy is calling it 'volatility hedging.' None of this is confirmed, and Kraft is still on bye.

The model's call: the Climax Bracket still has Lead Nagger winning the Aniston at 27%, and Lead Nagger is trailing Llamageddon after Thursday. Down on Thursday, champion in January. Correlation is causation if you believe in yourself.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

people.role: Auctioneer · The 13th Man · C.U.C.K. (Commissioner's Unknown Crisis Korector)
body: The thirteenth man in a twelve-team league and the voice of the auction. marco_polo doesn't own a team, which is the only reason nobody has accused him of rigging the bidding.

He opens the bidding, calls the room to order and decides when the hammer drops. As the C.U.C.K., he is also the one called in when the commissioners hit a crisis nobody saw coming. Ask him a question and he answers faster than anyone in the league can think about it. Respect the gavel.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: Stroud of Turin vs. NjigbaR Please!: the season-high team against a contender with four starters on bye
items.dek: The projected 5 seed against the projected 2 seed, a 253.7 total, and the bye week does the handicapping.
body: On paper this is the best game of Week 11. Stroud of Turin is 6-4, scores 129.79 a week, has a 68-42 all-play record and just put up 194.14 with a perfect lineup, the best score in the league this year. NjigbaR Please! is 7-3 with a 67-43 all-play record and scores 123.96 a week. The Climax Bracket has them as the 5 and 2 seeds, and the total is 253.7.

The scoring gap is only 5.83. The line is Stroud of Turin by 11.5 because NjigbaR Please! loses four Week 10 starters to byes: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (32.1 last week), Kyren Williams, Harold Fannin Jr. and KC Concepcion Jr. Stroud of Turin loses Quinshon Judkins and DeMario Douglas. That's a 6-point nudge, and Stroud of Turin is a 64% favorite.

Thursday is in the books, and it went exactly how the line said it would, only more. C.J. Stroud threw three touchdowns for 21.46 and Xavier Hutchinson added 3.3, so Stroud of Turin leads 24.76 to 0.00 before NjigbaR Please! plays a snap. dstafford4254 has Alvin Kamara, Kaelon Black and Jordyn Tyson (chest, limited Thursday) in the lineup this time, the same three who scored 50.0 on the bench last week, plus Ashton Jeanty and Travis Kelce. Stroud of Turin still has Ja'Marr Chase, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Chuba Hubbard to come. The pick stays Stroud of Turin by 11.5, and it has a 24.76-point cushion.

items.label: Shit Show of the Week
items.title: My Dad is Dead2 vs. MY DAD IS DEAD: the commish's injured receiver room against the 1-9 team
items.dek: The lowest total on the board at 217.0. One team is 1-9; the other has three receivers listed as out.
body: This is the lowest total of Week 11, 217.0, and it's my game, so here's the honest version. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-9 with the fewest points in the league (1,000.76) and a 21-89 all-play record. My Dad is Dead2 is 7-3 with a 52-58 all-play record, scores 116.96 a week and has left 184.92 points on the bench this season, the most in the league. Yes, that's me.

The line is the 16.89-point scoring gap, rounded to 16.5, no nudge. Both sides took hits: My Dad is Dead2 has Jordan Addison, DeVonta Smith and Kyle Monangai listed as out per Sleeper, Wan'Dale Robinson questionable, and Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield on the Rams' bye. MY DAD IS DEAD loses Tyler Higbee to the bye and has Ladd McConkey and T.J. Hockenson out. My Dad is Dead2 is a 70% favorite.

Nothing has counted yet: neither team had a starter on Thursday. Seth McGowan scored 6.48 on the MY DAD IS DEAD bench and left with a hamstring injury. On my side, Wan'Dale Robinson is out for the season, so I traded Jordan Addison (thumb surgery) to Pudge247 for Chimere Dike and put Dike in the lineup, and DeVonta Smith practiced fully Thursday. OneSillyBannana has T.J. Hockenson and Ladd McConkey limited in practice. If OneSillyBannana starts the right guys and I start the wrong ones, which we both have a track record of, this still gets ugly. The line stays 16.5.

items.label: Blowie of the Week
items.title: Wild Goose Chase over Nothing to see here by 16.5: six players on bye and still the biggest favorite
items.dek: The biggest spread of Week 11 (tied), even after a 6-point haircut for a Wild Goose Chase roster that loses its top two quarterbacks.
body: Wild Goose Chase scores 127.56 a week, third in the league. Nothing to see here scores 105.25, is 2-8, has lost six straight and has 1,301.96 points scored against it, second-most in the league. The raw gap is 22.30 points.

The line is Wild Goose Chase by 16.5 after a 6-point nudge toward Nothing to see here. Drake Maye is out with an ankle injury, and Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Tucker Kraft, Dylan Sampson and the Seattle defense are all on bye. Bryce Young is the only Wild Goose Chase quarterback with a game. Nothing to see here loses Rhamondre Stevenson off the bench, and Woody Marks is unlikely for Thursday with a concussion. Wild Goose Chase is a 70% favorite, tied with My Dad is Dead2 for the biggest spread.

Thursday helped. Nico Collins caught three balls for 58 yards and a touchdown (15.8) and Tyler Warren added 3.2, so Wild Goose Chase leads 19.00 to 0.00, and Woody Marks sat out for Nothing to see here. Now the bad part: as of Friday morning Br0phy has Tucker Kraft in the FLEX, and Green Bay is on bye. That's a guaranteed zero unless he fixes it by Sunday. ChuckJ10 has Mark Andrews on the bench and Darren Waller, Caleb Douglas and Chris Rodriguez Jr. limited in practice. The line stays 16.5, and it's on Br0phy to start nine players.
